## Outcome

Describe the user-visible change and why it belongs in the complete public product.

## AI and official-component boundary

- What remains an AI/Skill/natural-language decision?
- Which official `lark-cli` or lark-* Skill capability is reused?
- Why is any new trusted code unavoidable?

## Privacy and configuration

- [ ] No 真实消息、企业数据、凭据、飞书 ID/标识、原始日志、截图或本机路径 is included.
- [ ] Examples use synthetic identities and resources.
- [ ] Deployment-specific behavior is configuration, not a private source fork.
- [ ] Retention, message scope and authority boundaries do not silently expand.

## Verification and rollback

List focused tests, the full test result and a safe rollback note.

## DCO

- [ ] Every commit contains a `Signed-off-by` line.
